description: Judge every artifact of a chain at once and add the cross-phase check: every vision goal must reach a task. Returns the same shape as vdd_check plus a per-phase breakdown. Use it at the end of a cycle, or whenever a change touches more than one artifact.

artifacts.description: Phase name → artifact text: vision, strategy, tactics, specs, plan, tasks

declaredCounts.description: Counts you declared before generating, keyed goals / pillars / actions / specs / components / tasks. Each phase compares only the keys it consumes; omit it and no count is checked.

name: vdd_chain_validate

backward_sound.description: Children whose serves value names a known parent (invariant B)

dedicated.description: Parents with a child no other parent shares (invariant C)

forward_covered.description: Parents with at least one child (invariant A)

matrix.description: Parent id → child ids that declare it

reasons.description: One line per failed check, naming the id to fix

title: Validate a whole VDD chain
